result.brief: 为几何监督的潜世界模型建立有限样本学习到控制理论，用编码器局部-全局度量 hinge 保证度量忠实性与受控动力学近似半共轭，并给出规划与代价保证。
result.reason: Theory for geometrically supervised latent world models: encoder metric hinge preventing collapse, uniform controlled-dynamics guarantees, planning certificates—directly a latent representation contribution for world models.
